en.signaler.forstaHvaSignalerBetyr: Understand what different signals can mean.

en.signaler.registrertGang: This pattern appears in {antall} of {total} registered naps.
en.signaler.registrertGanger: This pattern appears in {antall} of {total} registered naps.
en.signaler.vissteDuTekst: A single signal rarely tells the whole story. It is often the combination of several signals that shows what your baby needs.
en.signaler.kategoriSovnUndertittel: Signals that appear when your baby starts getting tired.
en.signaler.kategoriPauseUndertittel: Signs of overstimulation or need for calm.
en.signaler.kategoriMageUndertittel: Signals related to gas, tummy or fussiness.
en.signaler.kategoriSultUndertittel: Signs that your baby wants food.
en.signaler.sovnStirrerTomtBeskrivelse: Your baby has a distant, unfocused look.
en.signaler.sovnStirrerTomtKanBety2: Your baby is starting to switch off
en.signaler.sovnStirrerTomtTips: Start calming the environment when you notice this.
en.signaler.sovnGjesperBeskrivelse: Yawning is a common sign of tiredness.
en.signaler.sovnGjesperKanBety1: Can be early or late depending on context
en.signaler.sovnGjesperKanBety2: Combined with other cues means sleep is near
en.signaler.sovnGjesperTips: One yawn alone is not enough – look for combinations.
en.signaler.sovnGnirOyneneBeskrivelse: Your baby rubs or scratches their eyes.
en.signaler.sovnGnirOyneneKanBety2: Your baby may be overtired if this continues
en.signaler.sovnGnirOyneneTips: If this is the first cue you notice, your baby may already be overtired.
en.signaler.sovnVenderHodetBortBeskrivelse: Your baby turns away from you or stimulation.
en.signaler.sovnVenderHodetBortTips: Respect the cue – do not try to reconnect immediately.
en.signaler.sovnMisterInteressenBeskrivelse: Your baby loses interest in what is happening around them.
en.signaler.sovnMisterInteressenTips: Reduce stimulation and move to a calmer room.
en.signaler.sovnTungeOyelokkBeskrivelse: The eyelids become heavy and half-closed.
en.signaler.sovnTungeOyelokkTips: Put your baby down now – they are ready.
en.signaler.pauseVenderHodetBortBeskrivelse: Your baby turns their head away from you or stimulation.
en.signaler.pauseVenderHodetBortTips: Wait until your baby turns back on their own.
en.signaler.pauseUroligIKroppenBeskrivelse: Your baby seems fidgety and physically restless.
en.signaler.pauseUroligIKroppenTips: Try lowering light and sound in the room.
en.signaler.pauseKnytterNeveneBeskrivelse: Your baby clenches their hands tightly.
en.signaler.pauseKnytterNeveneTips: Pick your baby up and offer calm before it escalates.
en.signaler.pauseBuerRyggenBakoverBeskrivel: Your baby arches their back backward.
en.signaler.pauseBuerRyggenBakoverTips: Check whether trapped gas might be the cause.
en.signaler.pauseUnngarOyekontaktBeskrivels: Your baby looks away and avoids meeting your gaze.
en.signaler.pauseUnngarOyekontaktTips: Give your baby a little time without pressure to connect.
en.signaler.mageTrekkerBenaOppBeskrivelse: Your baby pulls their legs up toward the tummy.
en.signaler.mageTrekkerBenaOppTips: Try gentle bicycle leg movements or a tummy massage.
en.signaler.mageKrummerRyggenBeskrivelse: Your baby curves their back and seems tense.
en.signaler.mageKrummerRyggenTips: Hold your baby upright after feeding.
en.signaler.mageRapperMyeBeskrivelse: Your baby burps often or has a visibly bloated tummy.
en.signaler.mageRapperMyeTips: Pat gently on the back and keep your baby upright.
en.signaler.mageAnspentAnsiktBeskrivelse: Your baby grimaces and looks tense.
en.signaler.mageAnspentAnsiktTips: Combine with other signals to interpret.
en.signaler.mageGraterVedMatingBeskrivelse: Your baby starts crying during or after feeding.
en.signaler.mageGraterVedMatingTips: Try feeding in a more upright position.
en.signaler.sultSugerPaHendeneBeskrivelse: Your baby sucks on their hands or fingers.
en.signaler.sultSugerPaHendeneTips: Feed now – do not wait until your baby cries.
en.signaler.sultSmatterMedMunnenBeskrivelse: Your baby makes smacking sounds with the mouth.
en.signaler.sultSmatterMedMunnenTips: Early cue – an ideal moment to feed.
en.signaler.sultSokerBrystEllerFlaskeBeskri: Your baby turns the head and searches for breast or bottle.
en.signaler.sultSokerBrystEllerFlaskeTips: A typical early hunger cue in newborns.
en.signaler.sultRastlosOgUroligBeskrivelse: Your baby moves a lot and seems restless.
en.signaler.sultRastlosOgUroligKanBety2: Crying may come soon if not fed
en.signaler.sultRastlosOgUroligTips: Feed soon – crying is the last hunger cue.
